notes.title: ”TriggerHeart Exelica Enhanced ”Release!!
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45653894/9c9031d5d061ac585435167b5ee0736c07e25878.png"][/img][/p][p]Hello everyone, we had the game on the store with a planned release date of the end of July, and we've finally received permission to release it.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45653894/edff7857fa4f317dda34d28335e94d5cb51adf2c.png"][/img][/p][p]Due to various circumstances, visual novel-like elements were added to this game, so the approval process took longer than usual.[/p][p]We apologize for any concern caused to those who have been waiting.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45653894/03100797bf42e53009a5f639c6c3d47984e85679.png"][/img][/p][p]We hope you enjoy playing the game.[/p]
